parsedVerdict.reasoning: LoanController is in the presentation layer, so its job is to map requests to service calls and responses. Its `lend` method also enforces a business policy: a loan must last between 1 and 60 days. It enforces this by throwing the domain error `LendingError('INVALID', ...)`. That policy is a lending rule and belongs in the business (domain) layer, for example inside `LendingService.lend`. As written, any other caller of `LendingService.lend` skips the rule. The controller also orchestrates the workflow: after `lending.lend` and `lending.giveBack`, it calls `history.note(...)` to record the event. Writing history as part of the lend and return use cases is business logic, not presentation logic. Everything else in the file fits the presentation layer: the request DTOs, HTTP status codes and `renderLoan` view mapping.

violations.message: LoanController.lend enforces the loan-duration business rule (days must be 1–60) and throws the domain LendingError. This rule belongs in the business (domain) layer, e.g. LendingService.lend, not in a presentation controller.
